nodes.description: Internal state variable holding the CEO address, initialised from msg.sender and used by onlyCEO/onlyStaff/onlyManger/onlyLiveMode modifiers.
Internal state variable holding the CFO address; recipient of withdrawContractEther and authority for onlyCFO.
Internal state variable holding the COO address; authority for onlyCOO (token creation, updates, mode switching).
Current contract mode enum (LIVE/TEST) gating business functions via onlyLiveMode.
Public address of the successor contract, set by setNewAddress under onlyCEO.
Mapping from token id to TokenModel struct (id, serial, createTime, price, lastTime, openTime).
Mapping from serial string to token id, used for uniqueness and updateUnsold lookup.
Fixed-size array of the ten token ids participating in the carve-up round.
Current insertion index (0-9) of the carve-up round; also used to reserve withdrawable balance.
Total number of minted tokens; incremented/decremented by addToken/removeToken.
Mapping from token id to owner address.
Mapping from token id to approved address.
Mapping from owner address to the list of owned token ids.
Mapping from token id to its index inside ownedTokens.
Multiplier applied to token price after each buy (110 = +10%).
Fixed ETH input (0.01 ether) required to join the carve-up round.
Platform sale fee rate (2%) used to split the buy price between seller and all holders.
Library function multiplying two uint256 with overflow assertion.
Library function subtracting two uint256 with underflow assertion.
Library function adding two uint256 with overflow assertion.
Public transfer guarded by onlyOwnerOf; delegates to clearApprovalAndTransfer.
Public approval guarded by onlyOwnerOf; writes tokenApprovals and emits Approval.
Public claim of a token by an approved account; calls clearApprovalAndTransfer.
Internal routine clearing approval, removing the token from the old owner and adding it to the new owner.
Private routine resetting tokenApprovals for a token id and emitting Approval.
Private routine assigning tokenOwner, pushing into ownedTokens and incrementing totalTokens.
Private routine swapping/removing the token from ownedTokens and decrementing totalTokens.
Internal minting routine adding a token to an address and emitting Transfer from 0x0.
Internal burn routine guarded by onlyOwnerOf; removes token and emits Transfer to 0x0.
View returning tokenOwner of a token id, reverting for address(0).
View returning the length of ownedTokens for an owner.
View returning totalTokens.
External function storing a successor contract address; restricted by onlyCEO.
Constructor assigning ceoAddress from msg.sender.
Public function replacing ceoAddress; restricted by onlyCEO.
Public function replacing cfoAddress; restricted by onlyCEO.
Public function replacing cooAddress; restricted by onlyCEO.
Switches mode to TEST; restricted by onlyCOO.
Switches mode to LIVE; restricted by onlyCOO.
Payable carve-up entry: requires exactly CARVE_UP_INPUT, records the token, and on the tenth entry derives a loser from block.timestamp and pays 110% to the other nine owners.
Payable purchase: pays the seller 96%, distributes a 2% bonus to all other holders, transfers the token and raises the price.
COO-only token creation using current block.timestamp; returns the new id.
COO-only update of price/openTime for a token that has never been traded.
Private routine writing the TokenModel struct, registering the serial and minting the token.
CFO-only ETH withdrawal that keeps carve-up reserves and sends the amount to cfoAddress.
CFO-only view returning contract balance minus reserved carve-up input.
Constructor calling setCFO and setCOO with msg.sender.
Payable fallback accepting plain ETH transfers, with no accounting of received value.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, admin initialisation and payouts.
Miner-influenceable timestamp (now) used for sale gating, lastTime bookkeeping and carve-up randomness.
External ETH transfer ownerOf(carveUpTokens[j]).transfer(bonus) executed while the carve-up round state is not yet cleared.
External ETH transfer ownerOf(_id).transfer(token.price * 96 / 100) performed before the token is transferred.
Loop of external ETH transfers paying the 2% bonus to every other token owner during buy.
External ETH transfer cfoAddress.transfer(withdrawAmount) in withdrawContractEther.
Pseudo-random loser selection theLoserIndex = (now % 10 + now/10%10 + now/100%10 + now/1000%10) % 10, manipulable by miners.
Token id parameter of joinCarveUpTen, transfer, approve, takeOwnership and _burn.
Token id parameter of buy.
Recipient parameter of transfer, approve, _mint and addToken.
Owner parameter of balanceOf, clearApproval and isApprovedFor.
Amount parameter of withdrawContractEther.
Serial string parameter of createByCOO and updateUnsold.
Initial price parameter of createByCOO.
Sender parameter of clearApprovalAndTransfer and removeToken.
Local payout computed in joinCarveUpTen and in the buy distribution loop.
Local TokenModel storage pointer used inside buy and updateUnsold.
Local index of the carve-up participant who receives nothing, derived from block.timestamp.
Local variable capturing balanceOf(_to) in addToken.
Local address variable holding tokenOwner[_tokenId] in ownerOf and the current owner in approve.
Local result variable of SafeMath addition.

edges.reason: CommonEth constructor assigns ceoAddress = msg.sender, giving the deployer unrestricted admin control.
NFToken constructor calls setCFO(msg.sender), making the deployer the CFO able to withdraw funds.
NFToken constructor calls setCOO(msg.sender), giving the deployer token creation rights.
joinCarveUpTen is guarded by onlyOwnerOf(_tokenId) which compares ownerOf(_tokenId) with msg.sender.
buy is reachable by any msg.sender in LIVE mode and transfers the token to the caller.
withdrawContractEther is guarded by onlyCFO comparing msg.sender with cfoAddress.
setCFO can only be executed by msg.sender == ceoAddress, controlling who may withdraw.
block.timestamp digits feed theLoserIndex, making the carve-up outcome timestamp dependent.
buy requires token.openTime < now and records token.lastTime = now, coupling sells to block.timestamp.
joinCarveUpTen uses now to compute the winner/loser selection arithmetic.
When carverUpIndex % 10 == 9 the function executes the timestamp-derived random selection logic.
joinCarveUpTen performs external ETH transfers to token owners before clearing carveUpTokens and carverUpIndex.
buy sends ETH to the current owner before clearApprovalAndTransfer updates ownership state.
buy loops over all token owners sending ETH while ownership and price state are still stale.
withdrawContractEther pushes ETH to cfoAddress via transfer without checks-effects-interactions ordering concerns.
buy calls clearApprovalAndTransfer(ownerOf(_id), msg.sender, _id) to move the token.
joinCarveUpTen repeatedly calls ownerOf(carveUpTokens[j]) to determine payout recipients.
clearApprovalAndTransfer first clears the approval of the token.
clearApprovalAndTransfer removes the token from the previous owner.
clearApprovalAndTransfer adds the token to the new owner.
addToken increments totalTokens, the value used as the denominator in buy bonus math.
addToken computes totalTokens via SafeMath.add(1), a place where overflow would be caught.
removeToken uses SafeMath.sub(1) and would revert on underflow.
removeToken decrements totalTokens after swapping the last owned token.
buy multiplies token.price by RISE_RATE / RISE_RATE_FAST outside SafeMath, risking overflow.
joinCarveUpTen requires msg.value == CARVE_UP_INPUT for participation.
buy divides token.price using SALE_FEE_RATE to compute seller and bonus amounts.
The _tokenId parameter selects the token registered in carveUpTokens.
_tokenId is passed to ownerOf for ownership validation.
_id indexes tokens in buy to fetch price and ownership.
The _to parameter is the recipient of the ERC721 transfer.
_owner is used to read the ownedTokens list length in balanceOf.
withdrawAmount is the value transferred out to cfoAddress.
serial is stored through __createNewToken and registered in idOfSerial.
price is forwarded to __createNewToken as the initial token price.
_from identifies the current owner whose approval and token entry are cleared.
The bonus local is the ETH amount sent by the external carve-up transfer.
The token storage pointer is mutated (price, lastTime) inside buy.
theLoserIndex holds the timestamp-derived result controlling who is excluded from payout.
length captures balanceOf(_to) before pushing, driving ownedTokensIndex writes.
owner holds tokenOwner[_tokenId] and is validated against address(0).
c holds the raw a + b result that SafeMath.add asserts against.

normalization_plan.reason: _tokenId is only meaningful as the token selector of joinCarveUpTen and its ownership modifier.
_id is exclusively the token index consumed by buy.
_to is the transfer recipient consumed by ERC721Token.transfer.
_owner is the address whose balance/lists are read by balanceOf.
withdrawAmount is only used as the payout amount of withdrawContractEther.
serial is only used as creation input of createByCOO.
price is only forwarded by createByCOO into the new TokenModel.
_from is only consumed by clearApprovalAndTransfer for approval/ownership removal.
bonus is the value carried by the external payout transfer in the carve-up round.
the token storage pointer exists only inside the buy flow.
theLoserIndex is the direct output of the timestamp randomness computation.
length is a temporary of addToken used for index bookkeeping.
owner is the temporary resolved by ownerOf before returning.
c is the temporary sum produced by SafeMath.add.
